framework.name: DISP / IRAP
framework.blurb: Defence Industry Security Program (DISP) membership obligations across the four security domains — Governance, Personnel, Physical and ICT/Cyber — organised by membership level (Entry, Level 1, Level 2, Level 3) so a client only sees what applies to the level they hold or are pursuing. ICT controls carry an ISM chapter reference for IRAP-facing engagements.

controls.t: Membership eligibility criteria maintained (Australian entity, ownership/control disclosed, no adverse security information)
Chief Security Officer (or Security Officer at Entry level) appointed and notified to Defence
Security plan documented, covering the governance, personnel, physical and ICT domains
Personnel security policy mandating screening, vetting and confidentiality agreements established
Security incident register maintained
Annual security report submitted to Defence
Foreign ownership, control & influence (FOCI) register maintained and material changes reported
Supply chain and subcontractor security risk assessed
Security incidents reported to Defence within required timeframes
Subcontractor DISP compliance flow-down required in contracts
Chief Security Officer / Security Officer completes Defence-endorsed security training
Notifiable changes (ownership, CSO, address, adverse security information) reported to Defence within required timeframe
Personnel security clearances sponsored and managed via AGSVA, appropriate to role
Ongoing suitability assessment (aftercare) of cleared personnel
Confidentiality / non-disclosure agreements executed for personnel with access to Defence information
Security awareness induction and annual refresher training for all personnel
Termination, offboarding and clearance revocation process
Insider threat awareness program — indicators, reporting channels and periodic review
Contact reporting obligations communicated to and actioned by cleared personnel (unauthorised contact / elicitation attempts)
Physical security zones established appropriate to the classification held
Classified information handling procedures documented
Secure storage of classified & sensitive material (SCEC-endorsed containers appropriate to classification)
Visitor and access control at facilities holding classified material
Physical security risk assessment conducted for facilities holding classified material
ICT system accreditation / authorisation to operate, with IRAP assessment where required
System security plan maintained per the ISM
Essential Eight maturity uplift, target level aligned to classification held
ISM control implementation and gap tracking
Cryptographic equipment & key management per the ISM
Cross-domain solution controls where systems of different classifications are connected
Media sanitisation and disposal per the ISM
Network segmentation for classified systems
IRAP assessor engagement and remediation tracking
ICT security incident detection and reporting per the ISM
